summary: Render subsystem object constructor. Delegates base initialization to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain with a size hint of 0x10 and flag 2, then installs the vtable pointer off_5ADD1C at offset 0x0 and returns the initialized object. Called by the DirectX texture surface factory.

operations.description: Call DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain(this, a2, 0x10u, 2) to initialize the base DirectX texture object with a mipmap chain, size hint 0x10 and flag 2.
Install vtable pointer: write the address of off_5ADD1C into the object's first dword at this + 0x0.
Return the fully initialized object pointer this.

unresolved: Semantics of the size hint 0x10 and flag 2 passed to DirectXTextureCreationWithMipmapChain are unknown.
Object identity and full layout are unknown; only the vtable slot at this + 0x0 is evidenced.
off_5ADD1C is a DERIVED vtable (VTable_D3DResource) per existing analysis; runtime role unproven.
